report.summary_en: Claimed ₹1,35,500; insurer paid ₹1,04,231. Our audit finds ₹10,615 recoverable through appeal on 1 ground(s).

findings.title: Room rent above your policy limit
findings.explanation_en: Your policy allows ₹5,000/day; the room was billed at ₹6,500/day for 3 day(s).

explanations.en: Your policy allows ₹5,000/day; the room was billed at ₹6,500/day for 3 day(s).
explanations.te: మీ పాలసీలో ₹5,000/day వరకు అనుమతి ఉంది; మీకు ₹6,500/day చొప్పున 3 day(s) కి బిల్ చేశారు.

findings.fix: ఈ రూ.4,500 మీరే భరించాలి. తదుపరి సారి రూ.5,000/రోజు లోపు గది (జనరల్/షేరింగ్) తీసుకోండి. అప్పీల్ చేయవద్దు.

policy_cite.quote: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses are payable up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day.

cite.quote: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses are payable up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day.

tool_evidence.tpa_reasoning: Single private room charged Rs.6500/day for 3 days vs eligible Rs.5000/day (1% of SI 500000). Excess Rs.4500 correctly disallowed per engine D-ROOM.
tool_evidence.advocate_argument: Clause 3.1 limits room rent to 1% of SI = Rs.5000/day. Billed Rs.6500/day x 3 days = Rs.19500. Excess Rs.4500 is correctly disallowed. No regulator rule overrides room-rent cap.

findings.title: Proportionate deduction on doctor/OT/nursing fees
findings.explanation_en: Because the room exceeded the limit, the insurer scales associated charges (₹70,000) by 77%, cutting ₹16,154. Pharmacy, consumables, implants and diagnostics (₹46,000) are protected from this cut.

explanations.en: Because the room exceeded the limit, the insurer scales associated charges (₹70,000) by 77%, cutting ₹16,154. Pharmacy, consumables, implants and diagnostics (₹46,000) are protected from this cut.
explanations.te: గది అద్దె పరిమితి దాటినందున, ఇన్సూరెన్స్ కంపెనీ అనుబంధ ఛార్జీలను (₹70,000) 77% చొప్పున లెక్కించి ₹16,154 తగ్గించింది. ఫార్మసీ, వినియోగ వస్తువులు, ఇంప్లాంట్లు మరియు పరీక్షలు (₹46,000) కి ఈ కోత వర్తించదు.

findings.fix: ఆసుపత్రి బిల్లింగ్ మేనేజర్ ను అడగండి: 'సర్జన్, అనస్థీషియా, OT, నర్సింగ్ ఛార్జీలు అన్ని గది రకాలకు ఒకేలా ఉన్నాయని, రూమ్ కేటగిరీ వారీగా తేడా లేదని' లిఖితపూర్వక సర్టిఫికేట్ + రేట్-కార్డ్ ఇవ్వండి. అది వస్తే IN-PD-NODIFF తో అప్పీల్ చేయవచ్చు.

policy_cite.quote: If the insured person is admitted in a room category with rent higher than the eligible limit, the associated medical expenses shall be payable in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent, except for pharmacy, consumables, implants, medical devices and diagnostics.

irdai_cite.doc: IRDAI Guidelines on Standardization in Health Insurance 2020 [IN-PD-NODIFF]
irdai_cite.quote: Proportionate deduction cannot be applied where the hospital does not follow differential billing by room category, or to expenses that are not billed differentially.

cite.quote: If the insured person is admitted in a room category with rent higher than the eligible limit, the associated medical expenses shall be payable in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent, except for pharmacy, consumables, implants, medical devices and diagnostics.

tool_evidence.tpa_reasoning: Room rent exceeds limit, so associated expenses L02 surgeon, L03 anaesthesia, L04 OT, L05 nursing subject to ratio 0.76923. Pharmacy, implant, investigation correctly exempted. Engine D-PD Rs.16153.85 is per policy.
tool_evidence.advocate_argument: Math is correct per clause 3.3 (ratio 5000/6500=0.76923 x Rs.70000 = Rs.16153.85 cut) and IN-PD-EXEMPT is complied (Rs.46000 pharmacy/implant/investigation/consumable exempted). But IN-PD-NODIFF overrides policy: PD is illegal if hospital does not follow differential billing. Evidence shows differential_billing=null, so cannot decide valid vs contestable without hospital certificate.

findings.title: Insurer paid less than its own policy terms allow
findings.explanation_en: Even applying every valid deduction in the policy, the correct settlement is ₹1,14,846; the insurer paid ₹1,04,231. The extra ₹10,615 cut is not supported.

explanations.en: Even applying every valid deduction in the policy, the correct settlement is ₹1,14,846; the insurer paid ₹1,04,231. The extra ₹10,615 cut is not supported.
explanations.te: పాలసీలో ఉన్న అన్ని సరైన కోతలు తీసేసినా, మీకు రావాల్సిన సరైన మొత్తం ₹1,14,846; కానీ కంపెనీ ₹1,04,231 మాత్రమే ఇచ్చింది. అదనంగా కోసిన ₹10,615 కు ఎలాంటి ఆధారం లేదు.

findings.fix: TPA/Insurer Grievance Cell కు రాయండి: 'మీ లెక్క ప్రకారం కూడా చెల్లించాల్సింది రూ.1,14,846, మీరు చెల్లించింది రూ.1,04,231. అదనపు రూ.10,615 కోతకు క్లాజ్ చూపండి, లేకుంటే చెల్లించండి' - పేమెంట్ లెక్క షీట్ జత చేయండి.
